title: MAP Sensor Circuit Low Input
shortDescription: Manifold absolute pressure sensor reading below expected voltage range.
fullDescription:
The ECU detects the MAP sensor signal voltage is below the calibrated minimum on KTM EFI bikes. This affects fueling and ignition timing.

Common on 390/690/890/1290 models with rough idle or stalling.

causes.cause: Loose vacuum hose to MAP sensor

fixSteps.title: Inspect vacuum hose
fixSteps.instruction: Check the small vacuum line from the throttle body to the MAP sensor for cracks or detachment.

fixSteps.title: Test sensor voltage
fixSteps.instruction: Backprobe the MAP sensor signal pin; should read approximately 4.5V key-on engine-off.

fixSteps.title: Replace MAP sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap in a new OEM MAP sensor and clear codes with KTM diagnostic tool.

whenToCallPro: If wiring repair or ECU diagnostics are needed.

faq.q: Can I ride with this code?
faq.a: Yes briefly, but fueling will be off and performance reduced.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Sensor High Input
shortDescription: ECT sensor signal voltage too high indicating open circuit.
fullDescription:
ECU sees ECT signal above the threshold, suggesting an open circuit or disconnected sensor.

Fan operation and cold-start enrichment depend on this sensor.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connector
fixSteps.instruction: Locate ECT sensor on cylinder head and reseat its connector.

fixSteps.title: Resistance test
fixSteps.instruction: At cold engine, sensor resistance should be 2-3k ohms.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Drain coolant slightly, replace ECT sensor with new O-ring.

whenToCallPro: If wiring break suspected or no improvement after sensor replacement.

faq.a: The fan defaults on so usually not, but cold-start mixture is affected.

title: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage
fullDescription: The upstream lambda sensor reports voltage below 0.1V continuously, indicating either lean condition or sensor fault.

fixSteps.title: Inspect exhaust
fixSteps.instruction: Check header gasket and slip joints for leaks before the lambda sensor.

fixSteps.title: Smoke test intake
fixSteps.instruction: Smoke test for vacuum leaks around intake boots.

fixSteps.title: Replace lambda sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew old sensor, anti-seize threads, install new OEM sensor.

whenToCallPro: If exhaust leak requires header removal.

faq.a: OEM Bosch sensors are recommended for proper closed-loop operation.

title: Injector Circuit Cylinder 1
shortDescription: Open or short detected on cylinder 1 fuel injector circuit.
fullDescription: ECU cannot drive the cylinder 1 injector properly. On twins like 1290 Super Duke this causes a single-cylinder running condition.

fixSteps.title: Inspect connector
fixSteps.instruction: Remove tank, check injector 1 connector for corrosion.

fixSteps.title: Resistance test
fixSteps.instruction: Injector resistance should be approximately 12 ohms.

fixSteps.title: Swap injectors
fixSteps.instruction: Swap cyl 1 and cyl 2 injectors. If code follows, replace injector.

faq.a: Ultrasonic cleaning sometimes helps, but electrical faults need replacement.

title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Circuit
shortDescription: No or erratic CKP signal detected.
fullDescription:
The crank sensor signal is missing or out of spec, preventing the ECU from synchronizing ignition and fuel.

Bike often will not start.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Locate CKP on engine case, remove and check tip for metal debris.

fixSteps.title: Replace CKP
fixSteps.instruction: Install new sensor torqued to spec with new O-ring.

whenToCallPro: If tone wheel damage requires case splitting.

faq.a: Without crank signal, ECU cannot fire injectors or coils.

title: Ignition Coil A Primary Circuit
shortDescription: Cylinder 1 ignition coil primary circuit fault.
fullDescription: Open or short on the cylinder 1 coil primary winding circuit. Engine misfires under load.

causes.cause: Spark plug arcing to coil boot

fixSteps.title: Inspect coil boot
fixSteps.instruction: Pull coil and inspect rubber boot for tracks or burns.

fixSteps.title: Swap coils
fixSteps.instruction: Swap with cyl 2 coil. If code follows, replace coil.

fixSteps.title: Replace coil
fixSteps.instruction: Install new coil and OEM spark plug.

faq.a: Yes, always install fresh plugs when changing coils.

title: EVAP Purge Valve Circuit Open
fullDescription: Common on US-spec KTM motorcycles equipped with EVAP. The purge valve circuit reports open. Performance is unaffected but MIL is on.

fixSteps.title: Locate valve
fixSteps.instruction: EVAP purge valve is mounted near the airbox on US bikes.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect or test
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat connector or apply 12V to terminals to verify click.

faq.a: Yes, this is an emissions code with no driveability impact.

title: Idle Speed Lower Than Expected
fullDescription: ECU cannot maintain target idle speed. Often caused by carbon buildup on throttle body or stepper motor faults.

fixSteps.title: Clean throttle body
fixSteps.instruction: Remove airbox boot, clean throttle plate with TB cleaner.

fixSteps.title: Adjust cable
fixSteps.instruction: Set throttle cable free play to 2-3 mm.

fixSteps.title: TPS reset
fixSteps.instruction: Perform throttle adaptation via KTM Diagnostic.

faq.a: Adaptation often requires KTM Diag or compatible tool.

title: Quickshifter Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Quickshifter strain gauge signal out of range.
fullDescription: KTM-specific code for quickshifter sensor failure. Upshifts and downshifts assist disabled until cleared.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Check QS sensor harness near shift lever for chafing.

fixSteps.title: Test sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Verify sensor signal voltage changes when load applied.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new QS sensor and adjust linkage length.

whenToCallPro: If sensor calibration via KTM Diag is required.

faq.a: Yes, use the clutch normally; quickshifter feature only is disabled.

title: Barometric Pressure Sensor Low
fullDescription: The internal ECU baro sensor reports unrealistic low pressure. Affects altitude compensation strategy.

fixSteps.title: Clear and retest
fixSteps.instruction: Clear codes with KTM Diag and run a full warm-up cycle.

fixSteps.title: ECU update
fixSteps.instruction: Check for ECU software updates at the dealer.

fixSteps.title: Replace ECU
fixSteps.instruction: If sensor is internally failed, ECU replacement is required.

whenToCallPro: If ECU update or replacement is needed.

faq.a: Rare; usually a software-related glitch resolved by ECU update.
